crime: During free time, {WITCH_NAME} often played pool with another girl in the recreation room. Whenever she thought she might have touched the wrong ball or moved one improperly, she stopped play and called a foul on herself before her partner could respond. The partner reset the ball or took the next shot as directed. This arrangement gave her partner steady company and a careful opponent while letting her be the first and harshest judge of every mistake she made.

One afternoon, a second girl left the recreation room for the courtyard. On the way, the second girl leaned over one section of the upper railing and called back that she would wait below; the rail held firm. Soon afterward, the pool partner missed a shot and struck both knuckles against the table edge. {WITCH_NAME} briefly felt glad that the pain might make her partner easier to beat. She had neither caused nor worsened the injury, but immediately confessed the thought and called herself cruel.

{WITCH_NAME}'s partner said that anyone glad to see an opponent hurt could no longer be trusted to call her own fouls; at their next game, the second girl would make every ruling. The partner set down the cue and said, “I'll call to her from the upper railing before I come down.”

{WITCH_NAME} left first. Moments later, the partner leaned over the same section of the second-floor iron railing and called to the second girl below. The rail gave way. The partner fell into the courtyard and died. At first, the old railing seemed simply to have failed.
But one joint had freshly shattered while the surrounding iron remained sound. There was no bending or corrosion and no tool marks.

The second girl's earlier lean proved that both joints had still held immediately before the argument. From the courtyard, the second girl had watched the upper hall without a break. Only {WITCH_NAME} came within striking reach before the partner arrived, though the rail hid the witch's hands. Sound iron could not shatter without a heavy impact or a tool trace. The witch had used Shattering Blow on one joint while the rail hid her hands from view. The other joint kept the section aligned until the partner's announced lean tore the remaining joint free and caused the partner's fatal fall into the courtyard.
fields.epitaph: She sentenced the thought first; only the deed bore the final seal.
execution: An enormous iron stamp hangs above her as she lies strapped flat to the execution stand. She begins condemning herself aloud. When her words end, the stamp drops face-first. Its flat iron face strikes her head and chest, crushing her skull and rib cage against the stand. The stamp stays down, with her dead beneath it.

magic.name: Shattering Blow
magic.text: She can make anything she strikes shatter.
